services.name: The 2 Hour Scenic Route Boat Charter
services.desc: Enjoy your 2 hour cruise along beautiful Lake Tahoe! About your charter: The scenic route is a two-hour tour that takes you on a fantastic, fun, and picture-perfect tour to Emerald Bay, Vikingsholm Castle, and D.L. Bliss State Park. However, we are not limited just to Emerald Bay. Our charters are private, meaning we can go wherever you'd like. Stop waiting and get booking, our slots fill up fast and this is one tour you don't want to miss. Booking Rules: No Smoking, No Drug Use. You are welcome to bring whatever food you want to eat. services.name: 4.5 Hours Of Bliss Boat Charter
services.desc: All aboard our four and 1/2 hour tour of beautiful Lake Tahoe! About your charter: Tahoe Emerald Bliss Boat Tour takes you along the shoreline of Lake Tahoe from the Tahoe Keys to Rubicon Point. We venture to Emerald Bay see Fannette Island explore Vikingsholm and Eagle Falls then off to the cliffs of DL Bliss state park and rubicon bay. This tour provides time for swimming and relaxing at anchor as well. Don’t miss out on this once-in-a-lifetime adventure and private boat tour. Booking Rules: No Smoking, No Drug Use.
